page.layout: Top: running head in a decorative banner. Below it, an ornamental border (not text). Full-width title block, centred. Then the heading PRÆFATIO. One text column of running text with a large initial N. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.head: RODOLPHI GOCLENII ACVTISSIMI PHILOSOPHI, ET. seculo hoc nostro facile Principis, ad liberalis ingenii LECTORES
PRÆFATIO.
main_text.p: NEcessaria ac vtilis, liberalique ingenio digna est Scientia illa antiquorū Philosophorum nondum prorsus desita, quæ commu-nis sapientia dicitur, quod Ens vniuerse absoluteque contempletur. Tale enim νοη-τὸν nulla scientia particularis pro subiecto sibi vindicare, nec instrumentum doctrinarum omnium Logica sine multis mo-dis, & ceu differentiis Entis explicari potest: Vniuersa denique hæc doctrina & sapientia intellectum hominis perficit & quasi ingeniorum cos est, cum sit ἀφαιρετικὴ, hoc est, rerum cognitionem, vt miscentur in materia, non profiteatur, sicut

page.notes: Printed text at the top: the banner reads "RODOLPH. GOCLENIVS" and is taken as running head. The title block and PRÆFATIO. are set as level-1 heads. The Greek words νοη-τὸν (line-end hyphen) and ἀφαιρετικὴ are copied as read; both accents are doubtful, so check them against a larger scan. The "ET." at the end of the second title line carries a period as seen. Long s is written as plain s throughout ("desita", "cos est"). The word "in" at lower right is the catchword. No page number or signature is printed. A faint digitiser credit at the bottom right and a small mark near the bottom left are not transcribed.
